brand.title: Follow the board. Build the stack.
brand.copy: A mobile-first weekly board that blends morning mobility or flexibility, evening gym work, daily calisthenics, and explicit skill practice so you can just follow the day and keep moving forward.

week.label: Mar 30 - Apr 5, 2026
week.focus: Monday was missed, Tuesday turned into only an easy run, and Wednesday morning was also missed, so the first true gym session now starts Wednesday evening. The rest of the week is rebuilt as re-entry bridge -> lower -> upper -> athletic posterior chain instead of pretending the earlier work happened.
week.rhythm: Wednesday evening starts the week for real, then Thursday-Saturday keep morning mobility and evening gym. Sunday stays full rest.
week.automation: Nightly adjuster Mon-Sat at 10:00 PM, weekly reset Sunday at 9:00 PM

tracking.title: Log what you actually did.
tracking.copy: Use the shared session log after each morning or evening block. The nightly adjuster and Sunday planner both read it, and blank `Completed` cells are treated as not done, so mark completion, effort, joints, and any quick note while the session is still fresh.
fields: Notes: short context if something felt off
If `Completed` is blank, the automation treats it as not done

skillTracks.title: Push + balance
skillTracks.currentFocus: Build shoulder line, wrist tolerance, and overhead stacking before chasing freestanding handstands.
milestones: Scap push-ups and pike push-ups stay clean
Wall handstand hold 20-30s with ribs down
Box or elevated pike press strength improves week to week

skillTracks.title: Pull + lever strength
skillTracks.horizon: Chest-to-bar -> muscle-up / tuck lever -> front lever
skillTracks.currentFocus: Own scap depression, chest-to-bar intent, and hollow pulling before explosive skill attempts.
milestones: Pull-ups stay crisp without elbow irritation
Scap pull-ups and chest-to-bar intent become stronger
Tuck front lever or skin-the-cat prep can be added later without chaos

skillTracks.title: Core + compression
skillTracks.horizon: Hollow hold -> L-sit -> V-sit / press work
skillTracks.currentFocus: Train hollow body, compression, and hip flexor control so every other skill gets easier.
milestones: Hollow body hold stays solid for 20-30s
Hanging knee raise becomes strict and controlled
Compression work starts feeling like skill practice, not random ab work

skillTracks.title: Leg control
skillTracks.horizon: Split squat -> pistol progression -> clean pistol squat
skillTracks.currentFocus: Keep lower-body skill work honest with ankle mobility, single-leg control, and squat pattern quality.
milestones: Deep squat position gets more comfortable
Single-leg strength supports eventual pistol and jump control work

days.title: Run-only ramp-in
days.summary: This ramp-in day was missed. Leave it logged that way and move on cleanly.

morning.label: Morning / off
morning.copy: Nothing happened here. No catch-up needed.

skill.label: Skill block / off
skill.copy: No skill work. The useful move now is to keep the rest of the week coherent instead of emotionally repaying Monday.

days.bodyweight: Skip the daily bodyweight block for Monday.
days.note: A missed Monday should not make Wednesday stupid.

evening.label: Evening / missed
evening.copy: The planned easy run did not happen.

days.title: Lower day missed / easy run only
days.summary: The planned lower session and mobility were missed. The only completed work was an easy evening run, which still counts as a useful re-entry touch.

morning.label: Morning / missed
morning.copy: The planned lower strength session did not happen.

skill.label: Skill block / skipped
skill.copy: No pistol or calisthenics skill work happened Tuesday. That work now gets redistributed across the remaining days instead of piled onto one session.

days.bodyweight: Skip the daily bodyweight block for Tuesday. Start it again on Wednesday evening.
days.note: The easy run helps, but it does not magically replace the missed lower gym session.
swaps: Easy run -> incline walk if joints felt off
Easy run -> bike flush if legs felt heavy

days.title: Re-entry full body + handstand line / evening gym
days.summary: This is the first true gym session of the week, so treat it as a bridge day. Touch the big patterns, wake up the shoulders and hips, and leave enough in the tank to train properly Thursday-Saturday.

morning.label: Morning / missed mobility
morning.copy: Wednesday morning mobility was also missed, so tonight needs a longer warm-up before any real work starts.

skill.label: Skill block / handstand line
skill.copy: Keep this clean and technical. The goal is shoulder stacking and line awareness, not fatigue.

days.bodyweight: Use about 70-80% of the usual daily targets after the skill block tonight: 1 set push-ups, 1 set dips, 2 sets pull-ups, and 1 set squats, all kept clearly submaximal.
days.note: Because the week is starting late, a clean moderate session is better than forcing a fake hero day.

evening.label: Evening / gym
bullets: 10-12 min full-body warm-up with hips, T-spine, and wrists

swaps: Goblet/front squat -> hack squat or leg press
Incline DB press -> machine chest press or weighted push-up
Chest-supported row -> cable row or 1-arm DB row

days.title: Lower strength + pistol skill / evening gym
days.summary: Now take the first true lower day. Train hard enough to matter, but do not try to repay the whole week through the squat rack.

skill.label: Skill block / pistol pattern
skill.copy: Keep the single-leg work precise and balanced. This is skill practice, not a second leg burnout.
bullets: Assisted pistol to box 3x4 per side

days.bodyweight: Run the normal daily target block after the evening skill work.
days.note: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve on the squat and hinge today.
swaps: Back/front squat -> hack squat, leg press, goblet squat
RDL -> DB RDL or 45-degree back extension
Walking lunge -> reverse lunge or step-up

days.title: Upper strength + explosive pull / evening gym
days.summary: Upper density and fast pulling intent. This is where you re-establish crisp pull-up mechanics without letting the reps get ugly.

skill.label: Skill block / explosive pull
skill.copy: Build speed and scap control first. Keep the pulling crisp enough that muscle-up work stays a future progression, not a rushed one.

days.bodyweight: Run the normal daily target block after the evening skill work.
days.note: Cut one accessory before you let pull-up quality break down.
swaps: Incline press -> DB bench or machine chest press
Chest-supported row -> cable row or 1-arm DB row

days.title: Athletic posterior chain + integration / evening gym
days.summary: Finish the week with speed, posterior chain work, and one lighter touch on each skill ladder. The goal is to close the week feeling trained, not trashed.

skill.label: Skill block / weekly integration
skill.copy: Touch each ladder once more without turning the end of the week into a test.
bullets: Hanging knee raise or tuck raise 2x8

days.bodyweight: Use the normal daily target block after the evening skill block. If the week catches up to you, keep the reps clean and submaximal instead of forcing numbers.
days.note: Saturday should still leave Sunday as a real rest day.

evening.label: Evening / gym
bullets: Line hops or jump rope 5 min

swaps: Trap-bar deadlift -> conventional deadlift, rack pull, heavy RDL
Kettlebell swing -> med-ball slam or explosive DB hinge
Line hops -> pogo jumps or jump rope

days.title: Full rest day
days.summary: No training. No catch-up session. Let the system reset so next week starts clean.

morning.label: Morning / off
morning.copy: No gym. Walk if you want, but the day is for recovery.

skill.label: Skill block / off
skill.copy: Rest is part of the skill plan. You get better at hard things by practicing them fresh next week.

days.bodyweight: Rest from the daily bodyweight work today.
days.note: A short easy walk is fine. Turning Sunday into a stealth training day is not.

evening.label: Evening / off
evening.copy: No formal mobility required. If you feel stiff, do 5-10 easy minutes only.
